description: This file defines the EmployeeDetailedModel class within the OrangeHRM PIM API module. It models detailed employee information, including personal details, job title, subdivision, employment status, and supervisors, and is intended for serialization and API responses.

classes.name: EmployeeDetailedModel
classes.description: A data model class for representing detailed employee data for serialization in API responses, including personal and organizational details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the EmployeeDetailedModel with an Employee entity and sets up filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
